title: The gap between open and closed AI models in cyber capabilities keeps shrinking
title_en: The gap between open and closed AI models in cyber capabilities keeps shrinking
author: THE DECODER
content_snippet:
In the Vals AI benchmark, OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol Daybreak hits 80.8 percent of attack objectives in simulated corporate networks. Worse, the open-weight model DeepSeek V4.1 Flash reaches 72.8 percent at a tenth of the cost. Because open models can no longer be restricted, analysts say the window for defenders is shrinking fast.

The article The gap between open and closed AI models in cyber capabilities keeps shrinking appeared first on The Decoder.
summary_en: Recent benchmarks reveal that open-weights models like DeepSeek V4.1 Flash reach 72.8% success in simulated network attacks, closing the gap with closed-source models. Since open models cannot be restricted, experts warn that the window for effective cyber defense is narrowing rapidly.

title: Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff
title_en: Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff
author: THE DECODER
content_snippet:
A Google Research AI can detect signs of high blood pressure using a regular smartwatch, with no blood pressure cuff needed for calibration. The AI relies on two sensors already built into modern watches—a pulse sensor and a motion sensor—according to a Google blog post. The study was published in Nature.

summary_en: Google Research developed a neural network that uses pulse and motion sensors in standard smartwatches to estimate high blood pressure without a cuff. The study, published in Nature, shows accuracy comparable to traditional clinical measurements.

title: OpenAI lands an $11 billion funding round, but has to court dentists for more capital

author: THE DECODER
content_snippet:
OpenAI has received roughly $11 billion in new funding, the first tranche of a round valuing the company at $1.25 trillion. The money was wired on Friday, Bloomberg reports. The full round could grow to $20 billion, with the rest expected in the coming weeks. OpenAI originally sought $30 billion at a $1.4 trillion valuation but scaled back after an AI-sector selloff. Anthropic's valuation is also under pressure ahead of its planned IPO.

author: Ars Technica
content_snippet:
State tries to obtain broadband funds despite rejecting Trump admin condition.

California is accepting $1.42 billion in broadband grant funding from the Trump administration, but the state is not accepting the Trump administration’s demand that it stop enforcing a net neutrality law and other telecom regulations.

California’s stand against the Trump administration could result in multiple legal battles involving the state, federal government, and Internet providers seeking government funds. Al
summary_en: California has accepted $1.42 billion in federal broadband grants from the BEAD program to connect over 270,000 locations while explicitly challenging the Trump administration's mandate to halt state-level net neutrality enforcement. Despite federal rules conditioning funds on abandoning local rate and net neutrality regulations, the state is taking the money while reserving the right to litigate. This standoff sets the stage for high-stakes legal battles between state regulators, the federal government, and internet service providers.

title: Rapid LLM development is outrunning the research meant to explain it, study finds
title_en: Rapid LLM development is outrunning the research meant to explain it, study finds
author: THE DECODER
content_snippet:

The article Rapid LLM development is outrunning the research meant to explain it, study finds appeared first on The Decoder.
summary_en: Stanford researchers analyzed 50 widely cited claims about LLMs, finding that 44% are obsolete and 34% have significantly weakened, with an average shelf life of just 15.7 months. title: AI Inference Startup Fal Raises Capital at $16 Billion Valuation
title_en: AI Inference Startup Fal Raises Capital at $16 Billion Valuation
author: Natasha Mascarenhas
content_snippet: Fal, an AI inference startup that hosts image, video and audio models for creators and developers, has doubled its valuation to $16 billion in a new round of funding.
summary_en: AI inference startup Fal raised $1.3 billion led by Bessemer, doubling its valuation to $16 billion from $8 billion in April. Providing inference services for image, video, and audio models, the company has reached an $800 million annual revenue run rate, marking it as a top-tier player in AI infrastructure.
